tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exceptions. This is reinforced by the recorded rule of https everywhere, with no exceptions, so connections are not downgraded to plain http and verification is not switched off for development.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
